name: 挡土墙主动土压力分析
nameEn: Retaining Wall Active Earth Pressure Analysis
description: 分析悬臂式挡土墙在填土自重作用下的主动土压力分布和稳定性。挡墙高度H=4m，底板宽B=2.4m，立板厚t=0.3m。墙后填土参数：内摩擦角φ=30°，重度γ=18kN/m³，粘聚力c=0(无粘性土)。采用Rankine主动土压力理论计算：主动土压力系数Ka=tan²(45°-φ/2)=0.333，总主动土压力Pa=γH²Ka/2=48kN/m，作用点距墙底H/3=1.33m。通过有限元分析验证土压力分布(三角形分布)、墙身弯矩和挡墙位移，对比Rankine理论解与FEA结果。同时验算抗倾覆和抗滑移稳定性安全系数。
design_code: GB 50330-2013 建筑边坡工程技术规范; JGJ 120-2012 建筑基坑支护技术规程

theoretical.formula: Rankine active earth pressure: Ka = tan²(45° - φ/2) = tan²(30°) = 0.333; Lateral pressure at depth z: p_a(z) = γ·z·Ka = 18e3 × z × 0.333 = 5994·z Pa; Total active force per unit length: Pa = γ·H²·Ka/2 = 18e3 × 4² × 0.333/2 = 48000 N/m = 48 kN/m; Point of application: h_a = H/3 = 4/3 = 1.333 m from base; Overturning moment: M_ot = Pa × h_a = 48000 × 1.333 = 64000 N·m/m; Stabilizing moment (self-weight): W_wall ≈ (0.3×3.8 + 2.4×0.4) × 25e3 = (1.14 + 0.96) × 25e3 = 52500 N/m; M_st = W × B/2 = 52500 × 1.2 = 63000 N·m/m; Factor of safety against overturning: K_ot = M_st/M_ot = 63000/64000 = 0.984 (needs redesign); With proper geometry: K_ot should be ≥ 1.5; Factor of safety against sliding: K_sl = μ·W/Pa = 0.4×52500/48000 = 0.438 (needs redesign); Note: actual design includes soil on heel, increasing stabilizing forces significantly
theoretical.reference: Rankine, W.J.M. On the Stability of Loose Earth; GB 50330-2013 建筑边坡工程技术规范
